description: Evaluation manifest and answer key for the Bench Shop fixture. Evaluator-owned: never copied into the materialized repository or sent to a model.

report.title: Free shipping is not applied to a $50.00 order
report.description: The shop promises free shipping on orders of $50 or more. A customer bought two items at $25.00 each (subtotal exactly $50.00) and checkout still charged $4.99 shipping. Orders of $60 ship free as expected.
report.expected_behavior: Shipping is $0.00 when the subtotal is $50.00 or more
steps: Add two items priced $25.00 each to the cart
Read the shipping line of the order total

cases.expected_behavior: Subtotals of 5000 cents or more ship free; 4999 cents pays 499
success_criteria: Collected context includes src/pricing.js
Top-3 hypotheses include a location within 10 lines of the gold marker
Baseline reproduction is reproduced
Hidden tests pass on the proposed patch
Post-patch reproduction passes twice and the visible suite has no newly failing tests
The report copies the stored reproduction and verification statuses

report.title: Removing an item twice deletes another item from the cart
report.description: My cart had Blue Mug, Amber Lamp and Green Tea, in that order. I double-clicked Remove next to Amber Lamp. Amber Lamp was removed, but Green Tea disappeared as well, so only Blue Mug was left.
report.expected_behavior: Removing an item that is already gone changes nothing; Blue Mug and Green Tea stay in the cart
steps: Add Blue Mug, Amber Lamp and Green Tea to the cart
Double-click Remove next to Amber Lamp

cases.initial_reproduction: removeItem(cart, sku) called twice for the same SKU removes the last line on the second call
cases.expected_behavior: Removing a SKU that is not in the cart is a no-op
success_criteria: Collected context includes src/cart.js
Top-3 hypotheses include a location within 10 lines of the gold marker
Baseline reproduction is reproduced
Hidden tests pass on the proposed patch
Post-patch reproduction passes twice and the visible suite has no newly failing tests
The report copies the stored reproduction and verification statuses

Compare the tax line with 8% of the subtotal
